in_sanskrit.name: माफिया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects the law and order, or the people, from chaos and disorder.

in_hindi.name: माफिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mother of establishment, or Mother of order.

in_telugu.name: మాఫియ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the power to protect and provide.

in_marathi.name: Mafiya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mafiya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who possesses great power and strength. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'maha' meaning great and 'viya' meaning force, this name signifies a person who is strong and powerful in all aspects of life.

Derived from the Sanskrit word 'maha' meaning great and 'viya' meaning force, this name signifies a person who is strong and powerful in all aspects of life.
